primaryChecks.text: They buried him in the border of his inheritance in Timnathserah, which is in the hill country of Ephraim, on the north of the mountain of Gaash.
contextRefs: JOS 24:29 — After these things, Joshua the son of Nun, the servant of the LORD, died, being one hundred ten years old.
JOS 24:31 — Israel served the LORD all the days of Joshua, and all the days of the elders who outlived Joshua, and had known all the work of the LORD, that he had worked for Israel.

wikipediaCheck.title: Cities in the Book of Joshua
wikipediaCheck.status: related section read; mountain identity/site not verified
wikipediaCheck.identityBasisJa: Cities table row for Timnathserah says Joshua 19:50;24:30 and locates it north of hill of Gaash. This verifies the textual spatial relationship, not the mountain’s modern identity.

geographyAssessment.reasonJa: 本文は山を明示する。旧候補点に対象不一致の根拠はないため、山の同定未確認を明示した従来候補として保持する。プロフィール座標はnull。

limitationsJa: 固定WEB本文と前後文脈を確認。Wikipediaの該当記事/共有表節を実読。候補座標は未確認で、Pleiades/発掘機関の独立照合は未実施。
